description: A round filter button that expands into a list of filter categories, while a second circle beside it slides away carrying the icon of whatever is selected.
interactionNotes: Clicking the circle grows it into a panel of filter rows; the row of the active filter carries a filled check and the rest a hollow ring. Picking a row applies it, folds the panel back into the circle and swaps the icon in the circle beside it. The rows arrive one after another with a small stagger. The button is a real button, opening moves focus into the list, closing returns it to the button, and Escape folds the panel. Under prefers-reduced-motion the panel changes size in one step and the rows appear without the stagger.

props.autoPreview: Site preview only - the panel opens, holds long enough to read the rows, picks the next one and folds back on repeat. Leave it off in normal use.
props.items: The filter rows; each entry has an `id`, a Persian `label` and an optional `icon` component.
props.active: Controlled active id; pass it together with `onChange`, otherwise picking a row does nothing.
props.defaultActive: Active id on the first render in uncontrolled mode; defaults to the first filter.
props.onChange: Called with the id of the filter that was picked.
props.accent: Fill of the check on the active row; the tick itself is drawn in the background colour.
props.size: Diameter of the circles, width of the panel, icon size and row height.
props.className: Extra class for the row that holds the two circles.

tips: Labels are printed on one line inside a fixed-height row, so keep each filter label short; a long label is clipped rather than wrapped.
The two circles overlap by a few pixels and the panel sits above the icon circle, so the panel grows over it instead of pushing the layout sideways.
`accent` fills the check and the tick is drawn in the background colour, so any accent stays readable in both themes.
Panel height is computed from the number of items rather than measured, which keeps the size animation from relying on layout projection.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the panel jumps to its new size and the rows skip the stagger; the active state and the check stay.
